## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 85 captures during July 2026. Activity was completed in line with the site’s usual arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. There were no other operational issues noted in the information provided for the month.

The activity total represents the images submitted for grading during the reporting period. It provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 85 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.4. These images could not be assessed for grading purposes. The result should be considered alongside the overall activity level and the findings from the images that were suitable for assessment.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. These results require the appropriate follow-up under the established pathway. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during July 2026. Overall, the report shows activity at Oakridge Primary Care, with a small number of ungradable images and 14 referable results identified.
